desc_en: An essential piece for the sun-drenched season, designed with clean lines and a minimalist aesthetic. Crafted from select recycled materials, it combines contemporary commitment with sophisticated design. Ideal for moments of seaside repose, this exclusive creation is made to order and available with worldwide shipping.
